asset.subject: pirate ship attacked by a kraken at sea

frames.label: calm
frames.pose: wide side shot, pirate ship sailing on dark ocean, stormy sky, no kraken visible yet

frames.label: water-bulge
frames.pose: same wide shot, water swelling beside the ship, bubbles and ripples hint at something rising

frames.label: tentacles-rise
frames.pose: same wide shot, several kraken tentacles rising from the sea near the ship, ship still intact

frames.label: kraken-looms
frames.pose: same wide shot, kraken head and tentacles looming beside the pirate ship, dramatic but ship not damaged

frames.label: cannon-aim
frames.pose: same wide shot, pirate ship turns cannons toward the kraken, small muzzle glow, kraken threatening

frames.label: cannon-fire
frames.pose: same wide shot, pirate ship fires a cannon, bright cannon flash and smoke, cannonball traveling toward kraken

frames.label: impact
frames.pose: same wide shot, cannonball impact bursts near kraken, kraken recoils, tentacles flinch away

frames.label: kraken-retreats
frames.pose: same wide shot, kraken retreating into the sea, tentacles lowering, pirate ship still afloat

frames.label: submerging
frames.pose: same wide shot, kraken mostly submerged with only a few tentacle tips and bubbles visible

frames.label: sea-settles
frames.pose: same wide shot, pirate ship sailing onward, sea settling with small bubbles where kraken disappeared
